solutions.title: Level-order queue
solutions.strategy: Traverse level by level and link adjacent nodes in the queue slice.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is enqueued and linked once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue can store one level of width w.

solutions.title: Perfect-tree pointer walk
solutions.strategy: Use established next pointers on the current level to wire the next level.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every non-leaf wires two child links once.
